entities.summary: Anuja Chauhan is an Indian novelist and screenwriter. As a writer, she is known for The Zoya Factor (2008), Battle For Bittora (2010), Those Pricey Thakur Girls (2013), The House That BJ Built (2015), Baaz (2017), Club You To Death (2021), and The Fast and the Dead (2023).
